note: views_ical renders a View's results as an iCalendar (.ics) feed via Views plugins only (no settings page, no permissions, no Drush; configure=null). Real ids grounded in src/Plugin/views/: display 'ical' (extends Feed, adds a 'filename' option); styles 'ical_wizard' (recommended) and 'ical' (legacy); rows 'ical_fields_wizard' and 'ical_fields'. Installs a locked core date format 'views_ical' (pattern Ymd\THis\Z). Bundles eluceo/ical and html2text. Medium cases create views whose display config carries these plugin ids / the filename option and the agent reads views.view.* config back; hard cases build (or extend) a view with an iCal feed display, verified by scanning the live view config for an 'ical' display plugin or an 'ical'/'ical_wizard' style.

evals.prompt: I want to publish a subscribable .ics calendar feed from a Drupal view using the views_ical module. What is the recommended way to set it up — which display, style (Format) and row (Show) plugins should I pick?
evals.expected_output: Add an iCal display (display plugin 'ical') to the view, set the Format/style to 'iCal Style Wizard' (ical_wizard) and Show/row to 'iCal fields row wizard' (ical_fields_wizard), then add fields (start date, end date, title) and map them to iCal properties in the style settings. The wizard pair is recommended over the legacy 'ical' style / 'ical_fields' row.

evals.prompt: In the views_ical module, what date format/pattern do iCal timestamps use, and does the module provide a ready-made date format I can apply to date fields?
evals.expected_output: iCal timestamps use the pattern Ymd\THis\Z (UTC, hence the trailing Z). The module installs a locked core date format with id 'views_ical' labelled 'Views iCal date' using exactly that pattern, which you select as the date field formatter (with a UTC timezone override).

evals.prompt: Does the views_ical Drupal module depend on any external PHP libraries via Composer? If so, which ones?
evals.expected_output: Yes — its composer.json requires eluceo/ical (^0.17), used to build the VCALENDAR/VEVENT output, and html2text/html2text (^4.0), used to convert HTML descriptions to plain text.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a view named 'vical_wizard' that outputs an iCal feed. Inspect the live view configuration and tell me the machine name of the Views style plugin its iCal display uses.
evals.expected_output: The iCal display of view vical_wizard uses style plugin ical_wizard (the iCal Style Wizard). Found in views.view.vical_wizard under display.ical_1.display_options.style.type.

evals.prompt: On this site there is a view 'vical_named' whose iCal display is configured to download the .ics file with a specific filename. Inspect the live view config and tell me the exact download filename that is set.
evals.expected_output: The iCal display sets filename 'calendar.ics' (the ical display plugin's 'filename' option, which drives the Content-Disposition header). Found in views.view.vical_named under display.ical_1.display_options.filename.

evals.prompt: Using views_ical, create a new View with machine name 'vical_task' that outputs an iCalendar (.ics) feed of content. Add an iCal display and use the iCal Style Wizard (ical_wizard) style with the iCal fields row wizard (ical_fields_wizard). Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: views.view.vical_task exists with a display whose display_plugin is 'ical' and/or whose style.type is 'ical_wizard' (row 'ical_fields_wizard').

evals.prompt: There is already a view called 'vical_base' listing my content on a page. I want visitors to be able to subscribe to it as a calendar. Add a downloadable calendar (.ics) feed to that existing view using the calendar module I have installed (views_ical), and save it.
evals.expected_output: views.view.vical_base now has an added iCal feed display (display_plugin 'ical' and/or style type 'ical'/'ical_wizard') in addition to its original page display.
